csv_project_name: AE for New Affordable Housing & Mixed-Use Dev
csv_scope_of_work: The Housing Authority of the City of Atlanta, Georgia ( Atlanta Housing or AH ) is soliciting qualifications from licensed professional design and engineering firms (Design Services Firms), in good standing with professional regulatory agencies and leading industry associations, to assist Atlanta Housing on planning, development and capital improvement projects across its portfolio of property assets at various locations throughout the City of Atlanta, Georgia. The purpose is to maintain a list of pre-qualified Design Services Firms that can provide the planning, pre-construction and construction design and engineering services (collectively Design Services) necessary for Atlanta Housing to complete its aggressive plan for preserving existing affordable housing and for creating new affordable housing and mixed-use developments.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Housing & Urban Development, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
csv_comments: '- Project Number: RFQL#2026-0121- Project Funding: HUD- Pre-Submittal Notes: https://atlantahousing.zoom.us/meeting/register/_975gg30TQ2vPvebQlHo_w- Pre-Submittal Meeting: 06/10/2026 02:00 PM EDT- Pre-Submittal Location: Zoom Meeting- Pre-Submittal Attendance: Recommended- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 06/26/2026 12:00 PM EDT - Questions Submit Online,- Multiple Contracts may be Awarded Pre-Bid meeting June 10 at 02:00 PM EDT
title: AE for New Affordable Housing and Mixed-Use Development
short_description: Prequalification for design services for affordable housing and mixed-use developments in Atlanta.
project_scope: Prequalification of design and engineering firms to support planning, development, and capital improvement projects across Atlanta Housing's property portfolio at various locations in the City of Atlanta. The program focuses on preservation of existing affordable housing and creation of new affordable housing and mixed-use developments. No specific building sizes, gross floor areas, or structural spans are stated.
services: Planning, pre-construction, and construction design and engineering services. Requested disciplines include architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, housing and urban development, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style prequalification for multiple future projects rather than a defined single structure.
- Focus is primarily general building and housing development, not a specifically complex structural project.
- Structural engineering is included, offering some potential entry opportunities.
- No concrete information on size, spans, innovative structures, or architecturally demanding buildings.
- Mixed-use and housing projects can be relevant only if later packages include large or complex buildings.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is a prequalification for multiple planning and design assignments across a portfolio, so no realistic single-project construction cost can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is a renewable prequalified list for multiple future contracts over a 36-month base period plus 24-month renewal option, a realistic fee estimate is not possible from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Licensed professional design and engineering firms in good standing with professional regulatory agencies and leading industry associations. The notice seeks qualifications from firms capable of providing the listed multidisciplinary design services. No specific number or type of reference projects is stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: Not stated in the provided text; this is a qualifications-based solicitation to establish a pre-qualified list, and multiple contracts may be awarded.
contracting_authority: Atlanta Housing, Housing Authority of the City of Atlanta, Georgia, Atlanta, GA, USA. Contact: Sopheria Lambert. Phone: 404-685-4892. Fax: 404-332-0105. Email: sopheria.lambert@atlantahousing.org. Website: https://bids.sciquest.com/apps/Router/PublicEvent?CustomerOrg=AHA&tab=PHX_NAV_SourcingAllOpps&tmstmp=1461156275736
notes: Project number RFQL#2026-0121. Funding: HUD. Agency ID: 70935. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Contract duration is renewable with a 36-month base period and 24-month renewal option. Pre-submittal meeting: 2026-06-10 02:00 PM EDT via Zoom; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 2026-06-26 12:00 PM EDT. Multiple contracts may be awarded. This appears to be a portfolio-wide on-call/prequalification procurement rather than a tender for a single defined building project.
